scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('server/src/public')) fs.rmSync('server/src/public', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'server/src/public', {recursive:true})"
